message: 特別な調味料

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」
A blue sky that just screams farm weather. Today, I'm transplanting komatsuna seedlings.
Once the transplanting is done, making covers for the crops to prepare for dead winter.

name: Paqy
message: 「You sure are diligent, Lord Synn. It's a rare Sunday, so don't you ever feel like sleeping in?」

name: Synn
message: 「That'd be such a waste when the weather's this nice.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you'd sleep in if the weather was bad?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I have to check the apartment for roof leaks, and once I'm up, there's plenty to do.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So in the end, you're an early riser no matter what.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-dooooo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why do you assume it's not Soba? Is that wishful thinking?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not it at all.」
Suddenly marched into the kitchen, what was thrust right under my nose was a plastic shopping bag from "Inamiya Shopping Center."

name: Azel
message: 「Make it.」
Saying that bluntly while keeping her face turned away, Azel sat down at the table.
Peeking inside, there were three packs of "China 2000 Sichuan-Shanghai-Beijing-Style Ramen."

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... some for me too?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I just happened to bring three packs.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So you're eating three packs' worth, Azel. Isn't that a bit much, though?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it's too much to eat, yours truly will take care of the leftovers.」
With her face still turned away, Azel said,

name: Azel
message: 「I'm only eating one pack's worth.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want with the rest.」
Ah, so that's how it is.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Got it.」
Quickly chopping up some green onions,

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Azel. Did you get to see the Leica?」

name: Azel
message: 「The library starts tomorrow.」
I quickly beat the egg,

name: Synn
message: 「Then you're going to the library tomorrow. If it gets late, I'll come pick you up.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
Even though it's just that he didn't tell me not to come or that he didn't need me to, it still makes me happy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn. Your hands stopped moving.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oops.」
I add the beaten egg and green onions to the finished instant ramen to round out the flavor.
Add just a dash of secret-ingredient dashi to make it extra tasty, transfer it to a bowl, and it's done.

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go, sorry for the wait.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's eat.」
Azel deliberately pulls out a digital camera and snaps a picture of the ramen before,

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you for the meal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Digging in!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Delicious!」
As I slurp my ramen, I'm thinking about how Azel wears his uniform even on Sundays, though I'd like to see him in casual clothes once in a while, when suddenly.

name: Synn
message: 「Why what?」

name: Azel
message: 「I've eaten this exact ramen for every meal this past week, yet it's never been this good.」

name: Synn
message: 「A whole week means... twenty-one packs?! Five packs cost a hundred yen, so... a whole four hundred yen?!」
So Azel is richer than me...

name: Paqy
message: 「Did you put green onions and egg in it? It's kinda meh if you don't, ya know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I did.」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't put too much in.」

name: Azel
message: 「I tried varying the amounts. However, none tasted better than this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm.」
Azel started slurping his ramen again.
He kept tilting his head in puzzlement.

name: Azel
message: 「I see. You are using eggs from that mysterious creature.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami is a boy, so he doesn't lay eggs.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then, are you buying expensive eggs?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You won't find any eggs cheaper than the ones Master Synn buys!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, a pack of twelve is only 45 yen.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not understand. I have been making and eating nothing but ramen since last week, adjusting the ratios and cooking times...」
Tilting his head, Azel drank down the rest of the broth.

name: Synn
message: 「Once you get the hang of it, you'll be able to make it taste good.」

name: Azel
message: 「So it is you, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「I have tested various ratios, and the eggs I used were of higher quality. That being the case, it would not be strange if I had produced something tastier than this.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess that's true.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet, eating it here tastes better.」

name: Azel
message: 「Whether you are with me or not. That is the difference.」
Azel looked straight at me with an earnest gaze.

name: Azel
message: 「In other words, it tastes delicious because I am eating it with you.」
My heart skipped a beat.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... well, they do say food tastes better when you eat together rather than alone.」
What am I getting all flustered over?!

name: Azel
message: 「Chemical substances emitted into the air from your breath or pores must be making the ramen taste better. It is only logical.」
Am I an air freshener or MSG to you? That's kind of depressing.

name: Azel
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's so moved by Aze-ko's brilliant deduction that he's lost for words」

name: Azel
message: 「It was merely a rational inference. If I had an analyzer, I could determine what it is. It's a shame」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Azel
message: 「You find it a shame too, I see」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wrong kind of shame, man」

name: Sally
message: 「Smells so good~」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah! Prez is eating ramen! I wanna eat some~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. It's all gone」

name: Sally
message: 「Boo-hoo」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? Azel, why are you here?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm the one who wants to ask that」

name: Sally
message: 「'Cause this is my roost~」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-You two are living together?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like we're living together」

name: Paqy
message: 「Under the exact same roof, man」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez sure is big-hearted, huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「...So that's how it is. A male and a female sharing a single nest. Mated with a Demon, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Mated?! No way! I'm on the first floor, and Sally's upstairs!」

name: Azel
message: 「...I-I see. Right, of course」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good for you, Aze-ko」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I was merely confirming the facts」

name: Sally
message: 「Do you wanna live here too, Azel? If you do, I can lend you a room or something」

name: Azel
message: 「Not really... It's not like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey」

name: Azel
message: 「Hello」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. We already finished eating」

name: Azel
message: 「In a situation like this, is 'Hello.' not the proper greeting?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nanakaaa! Kaicho's being mean! He's eating ramen behind my back. Oh, soba! Gimme some soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Why is Azel here?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm taking it! Thanks for the fooood!」

name: Azel
message: 「I came to have him make me ramen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...That's it?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's it」

name: Paqy
message: 「She went out of her way to bring instant ramen with her, y'know」

name: Sally
message: 「Slurp, slurp, slurp! Yummy, yummy! So yummyyy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Is that right...」

name: Azel
message: 「There couldn't possibly be any other reason」
She didn't come over just because she wanted to eat with me, after all.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, as long as nothing happened, I guess it's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「What exactly do you think would happen」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly thinks the biggest reason nothing happened is Synn-sama himself」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. You came here to have a meal with him too, didn't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like that, his parents just asked me to look after him, that's all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, you too?」

name: Azel
message: 「Apparently, the chemical substances emitted from this guy make food taste better」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck is that!?」
